parameters.name: AliyunResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: AliyunResourceTags
parameters.description: The list of Alibaba Cloud tags.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the resource group. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the resource group. Valid values include:

- `PrePaid`: subscription.

- `PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupTypes
parameters.description: The types of the resource groups to query. **If this parameter is not specified, general-purpose resource groups are queried by default.**

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sorting criterion for the results. The format is `FieldName SortOrder`. `SortOrder` can be `Asc` (ascending) or `Desc` (descending). If you do not specify `SortOrder`, the default is `Asc`. The following fields are supported:

- `Id`: Resource group ID

- `Name`: Resource group name

- `Remark`: Resource group remarks

- `Type`: Resource group type

- `Status`: Resource group status

- `Spec`: Resource group specifications

- `CreateUser`: The user who created the resource group

- `CreateTime`: The time when the resource group was created

Default value: `CreateTime Asc`

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description: The statuses of the resource groups to query.
